title: Add compact RAG orchestrator playbook and local runner
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduces a compact, opinionated RAG orchestrator playbook (OrchestraLite) and a minimal local runner for quick experimentation and teaching. Motivation: teams frequently ask for a small, self-contained end-to-end example that demonstrates retrieval->tool-calling->response composition with step-level telemetry and deterministic replay. This PR provides: 1) a concise playbook doc that explains flow, contract expectations, and telemetry hooks; 2) a tiny local runner (NodeJS) that runs the playbook against a seeded index and a stubbed tool adapter; 3) an optional Docker compose profile for one-command local demos; 4) CI smoke tests and a website doc page. The description below includes a compact checklist and usage notes. Checklist: - [x] authoring guide: docs/rag/orchestrator-playbook.md (rationale, contract, examples) - [x] local runner: examples/rag/local-runner (node runner, seeded index, stub tool) - [x] docker convenience: examples/rag/local-runner/docker-compose.yml - [x] CI: .github/workflows/rag-playbook-ci.yml (smoke e2e + lint) - [x] website: website/docs/playbooks/orchestrator-lite.md - [x] step-level telemetry example & replay: examples/rag/local-runner/replay.json Why this is distinct: many existing RAG quickstarts focus on authoring or large orchestrators; OrchestraLite targets the middle: clear step contracts (retrieve -> decide -> call-tool -> assemble) and a small deterministic runner that teams can fork into their own tooling. Usage summary: clone, cd examples/rag/local-runner, npm ci, npm run seed-index, npm start --scenario=faq-update. For an all-in-one demo: docker compose up --build and open http://localhost:8080. CI notes: initial pipeline failed on docs-lint (missing front-matter in playbook doc), fixed in the second commit. Security: stubbed-tool runs only local requests; the playbook is explicitly documented as not-production. Related: links to Linear cards ENG-1248 (authoring), ENG-2157 (playbook telemetry).
